scope.authorization: Repository-owned local engagement fixture; no third-party production target is involved.

invariants.title: Terminal phase remains below the modeled violation threshold
invariants.summary: The bounded search reaches phase 3 and violates the modeled terminal-state invariant.
invariants.impact: A modeled terminal state that should remain unreachable becomes reachable within the authorized local fixture.
invariants.recommendation: Make the terminal violating transition unreachable and preserve the minimal path as a regression test.

invariants.title: Phase never becomes negative
invariants.summary: The bounded search checks whether the phase can become negative.
invariants.impact: A negative phase would indicate invalid state-machine accounting.
invariants.recommendation: Preserve guards that prevent negative phase transitions and keep this invariant in the engagement regression set.

invariants.title: Budget-sensitive branch remains unresolved
invariants.summary: The example marks this invariant inconclusive to demonstrate that budget exhaustion is not reported as a clean result.
invariants.impact: Treating an incomplete search as clean could hide an untested reachable violation.
invariants.recommendation: Increase the bounded search budget or narrow the model until the invariant can be classified as violated or not found within bound.
